D9b_stamp_rule_has_no_step.scenario: A guest replies-all at 10:30. Zoya's run logs it at 10:38. Capture's 11:02 run reads it in ad@, finds the msgid: row, and skips it under STEP 1. Even if it reaches STEP 2, 'only add a missing link' reads as a ban on writing to the body. Nothing gets stamped, so actions never works the mail (Booked, a sponsored no, and so on). The steps never repeat the preamble's rule.
D9b_stamp_rule_has_no_step.fix: In STEP 1 change the skip to 'skip any whose msgid: key an Activity already holds, except: a row without a "capture:" line gets that line appended (and any missing link), once'. Mirror it in STEP 2's parenthesis: '(only add a missing link, and the capture: line if it has none)'. A missing capture: line is also how to recognise 'another routine logged first'.

verdict: Not accepted, but one fix away. D3b, D2b and B10 now pass, and every earlier case still passes. D9 fails: the stamp rule is only in the preamble, and STEP 1's skip and STEP 2's 'only add a missing link' contradict it. Put the rule into those two sentences (D9b), then replay D9 once. Precondition: deploy capture on 2 Nov or later, so that STEP 0's 'Captured before 2026-11-02' stops selecting the rows it touches.
